purpose: Single source of truth for the current delivery: open editable_blend to continue modeling; use browser_glb for browser presentation. Previous READMEs and run records are preserved for history and do not reflect current state.

path_resolution.asset_base: main_checkout[platform] / generated_directory; if FILM_PHOTO_SHARED_ROOT is set, it overrides main_checkout[platform].
path_resolution.asset_paths: All paths and reports below are relative to shared ignored_generated/, not the active worktree. Code, configs, and docs are relative to repository root.

browser_glb.note: PBR derivative optimized for mobile with embedded textures; real-time glass shader differs slightly from Cycles. Edit with .blend above.

current_changes: Cleaned rear text and memo markings.
Rebuilt lens barrel and body surfaces with smooth black finish; inside features three multi-coated optical elements.
Adjusted body color to matching black while preserving leatherette texture.

continuation.instructions: Read AGENTS.md and SHARED_ASSETS.md first. Open editable_blend in Blender MCP at the specified scene; write new outputs to unique run folders without overwriting current delivery or source assets.

viewer.access: Devices must connect to the authorized Tailscale network. Check actual working directory and port before deploying.

update_rule: On each new delivery, update this file's version, paths, checksums, source relationship, and status. If releasing a new browser GLB, update models.json for the same model_id to preserve stable links. Verify file presence and checksums before committing to Git. Binaries remain in shared directories.
